caption: Cheerful children's sing-along song for preschool TV in the style of modern nursery-rhyme channels, warm friendly lead vocals with a happy group of cartoon animal voices joining on the chorus, call and response, bright ukulele, glockenspiel, bubbly sound effects, hand claps, bouncy bass, light drums, playful animal sound effects, catchy repeating chorus, happy, splashy, major key, polished modern kids music production, clear diction, easy for toddlers to sing along
lyrics:
[Intro]
Hey hey! It's the Paws and Claws Club!
Uh oh, we're muddy! Bath time!

[Chorus]
Splish splash, it's bath time,
Bubbles, bubbles, we feel fine!
Scrub a dub, rub a dub, one, two, three,
Squeaky clean for you and me!

[Verse]
Rory's mane is full of mud,
Scrub, scrub, scrub with lots of suds!
Shampoo bubbles on his head,
Now Rory's mane is fluffy instead!

[Chorus]
Splish splash, it's bath time,
Bubbles, bubbles, we feel fine!
Scrub a dub, rub a dub, one, two, three,
Squeaky clean for you and me!

[Verse]
Ziggy doesn't like the tub,
But she tries a little scrub!
Paws in first, one, two, three,
Ziggy's brave as brave can be!

[Chorus]
Splish splash, it's bath time,
Bubbles, bubbles, we feel fine!
Scrub a dub, rub a dub, one, two, three,
Squeaky clean for you and me!

[Verse]
Waffles jumps in with a splash,
Water everywhere in a flash!
Shake, shake, shake your fur,
Waffles is the cleanest pup there were!

[Chorus]
Splish splash, it's bath time,
Bubbles, bubbles, we feel fine!
Scrub a dub, rub a dub, one, two, three,
Squeaky clean for you and me!

[Verse]
Pebble loves the water most,
He floats around just like a boat!
Flap, flap, swim around,
Pebble's happiest sploshing round!

[Bridge]
Wash your face! Wash, wash, wash!
Wash your paws! Wash, wash, wash!
Wash your tummy! Wash, wash, wash!
Wash your toes! Splish, splash, splosh!

[Chorus]
Splish splash, it's bath time,
Bubbles, bubbles, we feel fine!
Scrub a dub, rub a dub, one, two, three,
Squeaky clean for you and me!

[Chorus]
Splish splash, it's bath time,
Bubbles, bubbles, we feel fine!
Scrub a dub, rub a dub, one, two, three,
Squeaky clean for you and me!

[Outro]
Squeaky clean! Bye bye, friends!
